title: The Test Runs button in the control-panel rail shows an empty square: give it a drawn icon like the other rail buttons
outcome: The rail's Open Test Runs button shows a drawn SVG icon in the same 20x20 stroke style as the other rail buttons, instead of a text check glyph that renders as an empty square. Its label, position and behaviour are unchanged.
acceptance: A test renders the control-panel rail with test runs available and asserts that the Open Test Runs button contains an SVG icon and no text glyph, keeping its accessible name.
The existing test that opens Test Runs from the rail button still passes.
The full gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
